name: safe-trade-rule-builder
description: Safe-trading plugin for KakaoPay Securities that runs entirely locally (no cloud, no external AI API). In-house: market-hours-guard checks that trading-hours changes (after-market, SOR window, US DST, exchange special days) are applied consistently across code and config; margin-rule-check verifies counseling scripts, notices, configs, and calculation code against the official collateral rules. Investors: safe-trade-rule-builder computes forced-liquidation deadlines and required deposits and turns trade requests into safe, manually confirmed rule drafts.

interface.shortDescription: 사내에는 거래시간·신용 규칙 점검, 투자자에게는 반대매매·안전 매매 점검.
interface.longDescription: Three skills in one plugin, all deterministic and local. market-hours-guard (in-house developers/QA): compares time values in brokerage code and config with an approved session calendar including exchange special days, flags stale, DST-unsafe, or ambiguous values, and generates boundary-time tests. margin-rule-check (in-house counseling quality/QA/developers): finds wrong collateral-ratio and forced-liquidation statements in scripts, notices, and configs, and generates rule-conformance tests for calculation code. safe-trade-rule-builder (investors): checks credit-trading collateral ratios against KakaoPay Securities' published rules with sources, and converts trade requests (structured by Codex as rule JSON) into explainable drafts with session and time-window checks, policy guardrails, and manual confirmation. No live orders.
defaultPrompt: SOR 적용 시간이 20:00까지 늘어난 변경과 수능일 시간 변경이 이 저장소에 빠짐없이 반영됐는지 점검해줘.
상담 스크립트와 앱 설정에 담보비율·반대매매 안내가 규칙과 다르게 적힌 곳이 있는지 찾아줘.
